title: Delete the unused internal/scanner/mocks generated package
verdict_evidence: internal/scanner/mocks/ contains 442 generated lines (mock_scanner.go: 380, mock_scanner_coverage_test.go: 62) with zero importers anywhere in the repo (`grep -rln "scanner/mocks" --include="*.go" .` returns nothing outside the directory itself), while internal/scanner's own tests hand-roll `fullMockScanner` (scanner_coverage_test.go:655-667) specifically to avoid an import cycle. .mockery.yaml:32-36 still has the `Scanner:` entry generating this dead package.

verified_anchors.expect: 1 hit ~L37, under the internal/scanner config block (dir: internal/scanner/mocks)

verified_anchors.claim: internal/scanner tests use a hand-rolled double instead, to dodge an import cycle

why_tier: Delete a directory and one YAML entry; no logic to reason about.
goal: Delete internal/scanner/mocks/ entirely and remove its .mockery.yaml entry, since it has no importers and the package's own tests already use a hand-written double for the same interface.
background: The mockery config's `internal/scanner:` block (.mockery.yaml ~L32-37) has only the Scanner interface; removing the Scanner: line empties that block, so the whole `github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/scanner:` top-level key should be removed too if Scanner is its only interface (verify no sibling interfaces are listed under it before deleting the whole block, not just the Scanner: line).
steps: Confirm no other interface is configured under the `internal/scanner:` mockery block: `grep -n "internal/scanner:" -A 6 .mockery.yaml` and check only `Scanner:` appears under `interfaces:`.
In .mockery.yaml, remove the `github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/scanner:` block (config + interfaces: Scanner:) in full.
Run `go build ./... && go vet ./...` to confirm nothing else was silently depending on the package (matches the zero-importer grep, so this should be a no-op).
Bump .mockery.yaml's version header if it carries one (check first: `head -5 .mockery.yaml`); if the file has no header convention, skip.
tests: No new test needed. Existing internal/scanner tests using fullMockScanner (scanner_coverage_test.go) must keep passing unmodified — they never depended on the deleted package.
edge_cases: If a future mockery regeneration run (`mockery` CLI via Makefile target, check `grep -n mockery Makefile`) is invoked without regenerating this entry removed, confirm no Makefile target hard-codes internal/scanner/mocks/ as an expected output path that would now error on a missing dir.
gate: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/scanner/mocks/... -count=1
notes: Pairs naturally with the sibling L4743 item (internal/operations/mocks) as one small cleanup PR, but keep them as two commits since the operations/mocks item has a wrinkle (see that item's notes) this one does not.
